name: Exp_RangeExpansionIndex
summary: This EA trades based on the Range Expansion Index (REI) indicator, opening buy positions when REI crosses above the lower threshold from below and sell positions when REI crosses below the upper threshold from above. It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant entries. The strategy is a mean-reversion system that enters when the indicator exits extreme zones.
summary_zh: 该EA基于范围扩张指数(REI)指标进行交易，当REI从下方向上穿越下限时开多仓，从上方向下穿越上限时开空仓。它支持多种资金管理模式、固定止损止盈，并在新K线形成时处理信号以避免重复入场。该策略属于均值回归系统，在指标脱离极端区域时入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Range Expansion Index（REI）指标，该指标衡量价格范围扩张的程度，属于DeMark指标家族。入场条件为：当REI从下方穿越-60下限向上时开多仓，当REI从上方穿越+60上限向下时开空仓，本质上是在指标从超卖/超买区域回归时入场，属于均值回归逻辑。出场条件通过反向信号触发平仓：当REI高于-60时平多仓，低于+60时平空仓，同时设置固定止损1000点和止盈2000点作为额外保护。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例、以及固定手数，通过MarginMode枚举选择。资金管理参数MM控制下单比例或手数大小，默认0.1在固定手数模式下表示0.1手。策略还允许通过输入参数单独控制买卖方向的开启和平仓，提供灵活的交易控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Range Expansion Index (REI) indicator, which measures the degree of price range expansion and belongs to the DeMark indicator family. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when REI crosses above the -60 lower level from below, and open a sell position when REI crosses below the +60 upper level from above, essentially entering when the indicator reverts from extreme zones, which is a mean-reversion logic. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse signals: close buy positions when REI is above -60, close sell positions when REI is below +60, with fixed stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points as additional protection. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size, selectable via the MarginMode enumeration. The MM parameter controls the trading proportion or lot size, defaulting to 0.1 which means 0.1 lots in fixed lot mode. The strategy also allows independent control of buy/sell direction opening and closing through input parameters, providing flexible trading control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制交易比例或手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative = fixed lot

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage limit)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 使用新K线检测机制(IsNewBar)避免同根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好的交易者
买卖方向可独立控制开关，便于单边交易或只做平仓操作
设置了固定止损止盈，每笔交易都有明确的风险边界
使用CopyBuffer前检查BarsCalculated确保指标数据就绪，避免数据不足导致的错误信号
pros_en: Uses new bar detection (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Supports multiple money management modes, flexibly adapting to traders with different risk preferences
Buy and sell directions can be independently controlled, enabling one-direction trading or close-only operations
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit are set, providing clear risk boundaries for each trade
Checks BarsCalculated before CopyBuffer to ensure indicator data is ready, avoiding false signals from insufficient data
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值较大，可能在某些品种上不合适且未考虑ATR动态调整
缺少点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍会入场，可能导致不利的成交价格
依赖自定义指标RangeExpansionIndex，如果该指标未正确安装则EA无法运行，增加了部署复杂性
没有持仓数量限制，可能在极端行情中连续开仓导致过度暴露
信号逻辑仅依赖单一指标REI，缺乏多维度确认，容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 and take-profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments, with no ATR-based dynamic adjustment
Lacks spread filtering mechanism, still enters trades when spread is wide, potentially leading to unfavorable fill prices
Depends on the custom RangeExpansionIndex indicator, which increases deployment complexity as the EA cannot run without it properly installed
No position count limit, potentially leading to overexposure through consecutive entries during extreme market conditions
Signal logic relies solely on the REI indicator, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation and prone to false signals
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈计算，替代固定点数，使策略更好适应不同市场波动率
添加点差过滤和时间过滤（如避开新闻时段和低流动性时段），提高入场质量
增加多指标确认机制，如结合趋势指标过滤逆势信号，提升胜率
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation instead of fixed points, allowing the strategy to better adapt to different market volatilities
Add spread filter and time filter (e.g., avoid news events and low-liquidity sessions) to improve entry quality
Add multi-indicator confirmation mechanism, such as combining a trend indicator to filter counter-trend signals and improve win rate

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致不利成交
单一指标信号缺乏确认，容易在震荡行情中产生虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有最大持仓数量限制，极端行情下可能过度暴露
risk_points_en: Lacks spread filtering, wide spreads during high-volatility periods can lead to unfavorable fills
Single indicator signals lack confirmation, prone to consecutive losses from false signals in ranging markets
No maximum position count limit, potentially overexposed during extreme market conditions

It uses configurable money management modes, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and processes signals on new bar formation to avoid redundant entries. The strategy is a mean-reversion system that enters when the indicator exits extreme zones.
